title: Rust: route Core, backend, ledger and CLI errors through MoriDiagnostic
body:
**Tier 3 — structural.**

## Problem
`RUST_GUIDELINES.md`: errors that point at source are one open `MoriDiagnostic` built in each crate's `diagnostics.rs`, with `mori::<phase>::<kind>` codes, spans and teaching messages. None of the new crates do this:
- `mori-core`: `Error { code: String, message, offset: Option<u32>, step }` (`ir.rs`). Parse errors use a few broad codes (`syntax`, `bound`, `type`, `unsupported`), validation errors have no location, and the lexer's `MoriDiagnostic` is flattened to a string.
- `mori-backend`: `Error { code, message }` with broad codes such as `mori::backend::target`.
- `mori-ledger`: `Error { layer, code }` rendered as `mori::ledger::{layer}: {code}` with no message, and underlying I/O errors are dropped.
- CLI: `CliError::Operation { code, message }` puts the code into the message, and every new error uses `mori::command`. Core parse errors lose their spans.
- Sherlock draft frontend: `DraftError` with `String` payloads, `DraftTypeErrorKind` (nine variants, one per error), and `ProjectionDiagnostic { code: String }`.

## Suggested fix
1. Add `crates/mori-core/src/diagnostics.rs` with builder functions that return `MoriDiagnostic`s with spans from token offsets, specific `mori::core::<kind>` codes, and help showing corrected code. Keep `mori_core::Error` only as a thin wrapper while the backend and ledger migrate.
2. Backend and ledger errors that point at source become `MoriDiagnostic`s. The rest stay `thiserror` types with specific codes and keep their cause with `#[source]`.
3. The CLI renders `MoriDiagnostic`s through miette, as `check` does for beta, and never wraps them in `mori::command`.
4. Snapshot each diagnostic with insta, showing the source (#87).

## Needs input
- This depends on #76: if Core moves onto `mori-parser`/`mori-checker`, its diagnostics come from there.
- Tests match ledger refusal codes such as `mori::ledger::signed-call: signed-version`, and scripts or agents may too. Agree whether codes can be renamed.

## Done when
No `String` error codes remain in the Core frontend, every source error has a span, and the CLI never reports `mori::command` for a library error.

---
**Working on this:** builds on #74. Read `RUST_GUIDELINES.md` and `plugins/moriarty-dev/skills/develop/references/rust.md` first; a deviation from the guidelines needs agreement before it's made. Before handing off, all of these pass:

```
cargo fmt --all --check
cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
cargo test --workspace
```

## UTXO workstream adoption

Tracked as `GH-I82` in [doctormoriarty<utxo>](https://github.com/CharlesHoskinson/Moriarty/blob/utxo/docs/utxo/doctorwatson/github/work-items.json) and its [EARS/consumer assessment](https://github.com/CharlesHoskinson/Moriarty/blob/utxo/docs/utxo/doctorwatson/github/issue-triage.md).

Shared requirement lineage: UNI-018, UNI-024. Retained delivery exits: U0, U2, U7, MC01, MC08, SP02, SP12. Cardano candidate relevance: EUC-016, EU-CON-003. This is a traceability mapping, not a claim that the issue or any parent requirement is complete.

Source preparation can proceed within the current user authorization. Concrete API/identity proposals and applicable independent reviews remain required where semantics change. Original suggested fixes and historical tool counts are proposals and observations, not automatic migration or test oracles. Keep public developer use permissionless. Run checks locally; automatic hosted CI is outside the current workflow. Existing native/proving/ledger limits remain in force.
